title: Matte Black Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Valet, 49-Inch Solid Brass Stand, Traditional Style, Allied Brass
description: Freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel valet, 49 in H x 12 in L x 10.5 in W, solid brass towel stand for bathroom towel storage and drying — available in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs. Traditional style floor-standing towel rack/towel holder with four pivoting arms to maximize space and keep towels separated. Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent scratching on floors. Brass construction is designed for corrosion-free, rust-free performance with a lifetime designer finish. Some assembly required. Includes towel stand. Limited lifetime warranty. Ideal for traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Allied Brass.
